# Pilot beta session and report template

Copy this template into the maintainer's chosen private notes location. Do not commit real session notes or recordings. Use the [readiness protocol](../pilot-beta.md) and redact before creating a public issue. During a session, ask the pilot to find the app’s inline `?` help and PI glossary (`/pi/glossary`), then explain an unfamiliar term without moderator instructions.

**Fictional example setup, not a completed session:** B00 uses “Pilot Alder” and “Pilot Brim” in “Example Region” on an isolated local profile. Numbers and locations are invented. No real EVE account, consent, observation, result or successful task is asserted below. Replace these prompts with observed evidence; leave untested fields as Not run.

## Session context

- Session alias: B00 (fictional placeholder).
- Date, tested build/commit and environment: Not recorded.
- Experience: starting / returning / experienced (choose one).
- Broad community category: Not recorded; no public affiliation or character name.
- Setup: one character / multiple characters; first-time / returning profile.
- Browser/device and viewport: Not recorded.
- Input/assistive technology: mouse / touch / keyboard-only / named screen reader; actual device or emulation: Not recorded.
- Consent for notes, storage owner/access and deletion date: Not recorded.
- Separate consent for recording/screenshots, if used: Not recorded.
- Moderator and maintainer contact: record privately.

## Task observations

Use **Independent**, **Assisted**, **Blocked** or **Not run**. Count a task as Independent only when the participant finishes and explains it without click instructions. Record the first blocker before intervention; do not turn assisted completion into independent success.

| Task | Outcome | Observable evidence / participant explanation | Assistance or blocker | Follow-up alias/issue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Explain access and required/optional scopes | Not run | | | |
| Link a first character and interpret skill readiness | Not run | | | |
| Add an alt, including another EVE account if relevant | Not run | | | |
| Choose goal/logins and one operating area | Not run | | | |
| Explain production, teamwork and modeled time assumptions | Not run | | | |
| Choose selling route and explain fees, depth/delay and limits | Not run | | | |
| Review/save a plan and understand build/checklist next steps | Not run | | | |
| Name the next Operate action and data-freshness caveat | Not run | | | |
| Find inline help and the PI glossary; explain an unfamiliar term in your own words | Not run | | | |
| Locate contact; complete keyboard/mobile task if assigned | Not run | | | |
| Understand a fictional missing-data/error case | Not run | | | |

## Confusion and safe issue report

For each point of confusion, preserve the observed behavior before proposing a fix.

- Participant expected: Not recorded.
- Interface showed/did: Not recorded.
- Task consequence: Not recorded.
- First attempt, assistance and retry outcome: Not run.
- Fictional reproduction steps on an isolated profile: Not recorded.
- Expected/actual behavior, tested commit/browser: Not recorded.
- Public screenshot/log redaction reviewed: Not applicable; none captured.
- Focused public issue and parent link (#53/#113), or private security route: Not filed.
- Owner and follow-up/retest plan: Not assigned.

**Privacy check before sharing:** no real identities/affiliations, character IDs, colony locations, wallet/inventory values, login URLs/state, tokens/cookies, private security reports or raw databases. Use a fictional reproduction instead of attaching private notes.
